versions.changelog:
zentao-work-stats 1.0.1

- Removed skill-card.md file.
- Updated SKILL.md with strengthened safety, privacy, and activation descriptions.
- Clarified only SQL SELECT (read-only) operations are supported.
- Added explicit requirements for user authorization and handling of sensitive data.
- Improved activation condition details and included more precise instructions for database dependencies.

zentao-work-stats 1.0.0

- Initial release providing comprehensive Zentao user work analysis reports.
- Tracks user activity using both main tables (story/task/bug) and zt_action operation logs for complete participation records.
- Ensures only read-only (SELECT) database queries; no data modification is performed.
- Confirms user, time range, and report path before generating reports.
- Supports SQL best practices: reserved word escaping and deleted record filtering.
- Outputs detailed Markdown-format reports including statistics and role annotations.
